problem: nada más + infinitive is a Peninsular turn. Colombian narration says apenas entró or al entrar. It is outside the stated dialect for narrator text.
authority: RAE, DPD nada; dialect decision docs/redesign.md

quote: Como no respire, mija, se me desmaya.
problem: como + subjunctive as a threat or condition is colloquial Peninsular. In the mouth of Gloria, a Bogotana, it is off-dialect. Same in ch202 Y como alguien me ponga corbata and ch179 como me ponga a llorar. Teach it for recognition, not as Colombian voice.
authority: RAE, Nueva gramática on como condicional; dialect decision
replacement: Si no respira, mija, se me desmaya.

problem: The graph teaches fila as the LatAm word and lists cola as the Spain pair (vocab-report, 40 uses of fila against 2 of cola in chapters). Inconsistent for a Bogotá narrator.

Since 2010 the RAE writes rio, guion and truhan without an accent mark. Chapters use rio 62 times and rió 11 times (ch055, ch058, ch061, ch062, ch066, ch070, ch084, ch085, ch086 and others). The same inconsistency in guión: the lexeme is el guión.
authority: RAE, Ortografía de la lengua española 2010, monosílabos ortográficos
